name: Chat Shell
description: The simplest working chat shell: a sidebar, an API key empty state with three steps, a composer and replies that stream in word by word.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person shown at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: respond
props.description: Returns the reply to a sent message, which then streams in word by word. Without it the shell answers with sample replies.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It fills the viewport height. Also accepts every other div attribute.
